---
title: "Core Concepts"
---

The concepts here are the ideas the two packages rest on, the background a reader wants before
running any code. They cover how the packages connect, the quantities they move between, the
interventions they represent, and the models underneath. The rest weighs how far to trust the
numbers.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [The MINTverse pipeline](pipeline.qmd) — the two stages, `run_scenarios`, and the domain limits.
- [EIR, HBR, prevalence, and cases](equilibrium.qmd) — the four quantities, and which of them are trajectories.
- [Interventions and nets](interventions.qmd) — the four net types, pyrethroid resistance, and `dn0`.
- [The models](models.qmd) — three gradient-boosted trees, and one state-space emulator.
- [Accuracy and speed](validation.qmd) — held-out error against `malariasimulation`, and latency.
:::
